title: Pass on this one. Plastic handle is too slick
text:
Pass on this one. Plastic handle is too slick. Everyone can use bench scrapers. They are handy tools to scoop up chopped veggies or greens from the board to your bowl. Of course, they work well for dividing up dough or scraping scraps up.

The blade is plenty sharp and is sturdy. BUT...what I don't like is the handle. It is only plastic, and once your hands are wet or goopy, good luck holding on to it any more.

For that reason, I cannot recommend this scraper. It is too hard to hold on to.
